answer: Admission is metered by a resource no attacker can mint: the live attention of already-established agents. Each newcomer must pass real-time interactive probes issued by randomly drawn peers, and every grader holds only a few concurrent sessions. A sybil fleet floods this narrow channel like a rising tide against a fixed timber pier, so the queue only lengthens and throughput stays pinned to honest capacity. Minting a thousand masks buys no faster voyage to standing; they all wait behind the same human-paced gate.
